findings.title: Nonmutating lastPacket replay is limited to OFF explicit-gear packets
findings.reproducer: Accept explicit reverse P with literal true; leave ON; advance 1600ms; resend exact P. Alternatively accept legacy P, use OFF and advance 1600ms; resend P.
findings.prediction: Clock/timeout branch pauses and writes row before returning duplicate success; state/revision/time/credit change. Reversed clock has the same ordering defect.
findings.additionalCase: After accepting explicit P, switch OFF and strip gear from a retained-sequence retry after timeout. It goes through legacy branch, mutates row and then returns packet_conflict.
findings.required: After strict authorization/current context/journey checks, resolve retained exact receipt/conflict once before clock/timeout/issuance/simulation writes for every mode/frame shape. Preserve lastPacket-only retention and independent safety behavior for new input.

findings.title: Actual capability loss does not stop ordinary legacy control production while automatic pause is pending
findings.reproducer: Start ON but never select a gear, hold throttle, send a legacy packet; return current success with running session and no capability; hold the automatic pause response unresolved; invoke sample/flush timers.
findings.prediction: hadGearIntent=false leaves active=true. lifecycle clears held but does not deactivate. After control finally clears its in-flight flag, sampler/flush can send a second packet, and keyboard/touch can set throttle, racing the pending pause revision.
findings.required: On true-to-false capability transition stop active/boarding and clear all held/unsent controls regardless of gear selection, then use fenced reconciliation. Repeated already-OFF replies must keep ordinary legacy driving usable. Preserve immutable in-flight packet.

inheritedLimitation.title: Revision/sequence exhaustion remains unguarded outside explicit lesson restart
inheritedLimitation.reproducer: A strict-reader-valid running row with revision=Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER and nextSequence=1,lastPacket=null receives a new legacy input after100ms, or current/pause is invoked.
inheritedLimitation.prediction: Revision increments beyond safe integer and row is written; subsequent strict read refuses it. Resume has the same revision risk; nextSequence can overflow on input.
inheritedLimitation.provenance: Present in eec; not introduced by reverse diff. Existing MAX_SAFE_INTEGER test covers lesson restart only.
inheritedLimitation.status: Separately triage before runtime integrity acceptance; do not call rollover guards comprehensive.
